<subject>OreX Resources...The New Approach to Cut IT Costs</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity define OreX Resources. Our agile hybrid delivery model, combining on-site and remote teams working 24/7, supports a comprehensive range of IT services—from application support, development, and upgrades to complete technology management, including data centre operations.

We can provide Tasman Ridge with our certified Microsoft and CloudStream experts at a rate of A$25/hr for your projects. With a workforce of nearly 500 staff and cutting-edge development hubs, our Perth Innovation Centre is regarded as the flagship facility of OreX and a major advantage for you.

https://www.orexresources.com/

Over time, our Global Technology Centres (GTCs) in Perth have delivered outstanding project results for our Australian, European, and Asian clients.

Our Innovation Centres (ICs) and GTCs offer the following services for our partners:

   a. Cloud Migration and Management
   b. Data Analytics and AI Solutions
   c. Application Re-engineering Services
   d. Bulk Logistics System Integration
   e. 24x7 IT Support and Help Desk Services

While all these services can be executed at any of our Innovation Centres, clients benefit greatly from leveraging OreX’s offshore GTC capabilities. Please visit https://www.orexresources.com/

This round-the-clock development and delivery model allows OreX to quickly scale project teams, run concurrent development streams, and maintain a virtual 24-hour workday on client initiatives.

Darren, please let us know if we can arrange a brief meeting to discuss this further. Looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Regards,  
Martha Soto
